dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト); uses ORCDBMAIN DB call pattern, COPY copybooks with .INC extension, LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM, typical GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL deployment

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical receipt (レセプト) processing system - inpatient disease name (傷病名) editing/maintenance module
purpose.summary: ORCR0670 is a batch/subprogram component of the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt software. It reads receipt detail files (RECE62, RECE63), processes patient disease name (傷病名) records, performs editing and validation checks, and writes updated records. It handles disease name editing flags, insurance period checks, and inpatient/outpatient classification.

notable_features: 16 CALL statements including ORCDBMAIN and ORCSJOB
LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM (called as subprogram or standalone)
INDEXED file I-O with DYNAMIC access mode
Japanese Shift-JIS encoded comments (decoded as latin-1)
GO TO used for early exit from validation sections
grpsys-prefixed lines suggesting conditional compilation or group system markers
verdict.notes: Source comments are in Japanese Shift-JIS encoding, decoded as latin-1 causing mojibake in the archived text. The 'grpsys' prefix on some lines appears to be a source-level conditional marker used in the JMA ORCA build system. File is truncated at 16000 chars out of ~32000 bytes total; the full PROCEDURE DIVISION logic is only partially visible.
